name: Shodai Roshutsu-Kei Mahou Shoujo: Lunaly☆Lily
original_name: 初代露出系魔法少女 ルナリィ☆リリィ
source:
An incident destroyed Luna's trust in people and now she's anti-social.
One day a strange creature called Shabi shows up and attaches to Luna.
She's not interested in its talk about becoming a magical girl...
But then a monster called Libido attacks.
For her own protection Luna must sign a contract with Shabi and transform.
In the middle of the battle, the media shows up and broadcasts the whole thing.
Now Luna is under contract AND the whole city knows her secret identity.

Can Luna defeat the Libido?
Can she bear the shame of public humiliation? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RJ179929.html]DLsite English[/url]]

In order to erase everyone's memory of her role as Lunaly Lily, Shabi explains to Luna that she must gather enough energy as a magical girl to cast the memory erasing spell. He gives Luna increasingly embarrassing tasks such as wearing a micro bikini to the pool all the way to walking naked in public in order to increase her S Energy levels.

This game contains some elements of RPG gameplay and combat.
translation:
一次事件摧毁了卢娜对人的信任，现在她变得反社会。
有一天，一种名叫沙比的奇怪生物出现并附着在卢娜身上。
她对成为魔法少女的话题不感兴趣……
但随后一个名叫力比多的怪物袭击了。
为了保护自己，露娜必须与沙比签订契约并进行变身。
战斗进行到一半，媒体出现并报道了整个过程。
现在卢娜签订了合同，整个城市都知道她的秘密身份。

露娜能打败性欲吗？
她能承受当众羞辱吗？

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RJ179929.html]DLsite英文[/url]]

为了消除大家对她扮演的月光莉莉这个角色的记忆，沙比向卢娜解释说，她必须作为魔法少女收集足够的能量来施展记忆消除咒语。他给卢娜布置了越来越尴尬的任务，比如穿着比基尼去泳池，甚至在公共场合裸体行走，以提高她的S能量水平。

该游戏包含一些角色扮演游戏和战斗的元素。
